dedupe_keys.name: earthquake brace bolt california residential seismic retrofit grant programme

description: Earthquake Brace + Bolt is a California grant programme that helps owners of older wood-frame houses on raised foundations pay for a seismic retrofit. In an EBB retrofit the house frame is bolted to its foundation and any cripple walls in the crawl space are braced with plywood, with the water heater strapped, to stop the house sliding or toppling off its foundation; it applies only to wood-framed homes built before 1980 with a raised foundation. It is run by the California Residential Mitigation Program, a joint powers authority formed in 2011 by the California Earthquake Authority and Cal OES, which also runs Earthquake Soft-Story grants for soft-story homes. Coverage: eligible ZIP codes in California. Access: programme rules, eligibility, registration, contractor resources and retrofit stories on the CRMP website. Licence: website content, no licence stated; free to read. Caveats: the site gives programme totals but not a public dataset of retrofitted homes, so loss-reduction effects need separate study. Simulation uses are as a reference for retrofit uptake, cost-benefit and regional seismic loss reduction studies of wood-frame housing. Related records: the San Francisco soft-story retrofit programme and FEMA P-58.
